desc: A W-Engine produced by recycling abandoned Bangboo shells. Though it's made from scrapped parts, it still caused some distress among Bangboo lovers. "No Bangboo were hurt during the production of this W-Engine." — the manufacturer had to include this note on the packaging due to protests from Bangboo rights organizations.
desc2: Equip to increase Anomaly Agents' combat capabilities
desc3: A W-Engine produced by recycling abandoned Bangboo shells. Its electrode cores made of recycled metals can release high-voltage charges.
name: Weeping Gemini

1.desc: Whenever a squad member inflicts an Attribute Anomaly on an enemy, the equipper gains a buff that increases Anomaly Proficiency by <color=#2BAD00>30</color>, stacking up to 4 times. This effect expires when the target recovers from Stun or is defeated. The duration of each stack is calculated separately.
1.name: Lingering Cries
